entries.example: It's very good value as well (or too).
What's more, it's open every day of the week.
In addition, they give you a free glass of wine.
She still won the game, although/though she had a bad knee.
They went for a walk despite the fact that it was raining.
They got there on time in spite of the delay.
I don't agree with a lot of his methods. However, he is a good teacher.
I didn't like the film at all. It was better than sitting at home, though.
Sarah is careful whereas Christopher makes lots of mistakes.
Lions, however, spend a lot of time in groups.

note: Presentation is prose with bold link words in sections A-D; no printed definitions, POS markers, IPA or sense numbers exist. 'and' is bolded in A but is discussed as the basic linker without its own example line; 'the fact that' is bolded as part of a pattern, not a headword. Entries kept verbatim from bolded items; exercise page excluded.
